Rishi / Marissa — drafting answers below. Please review and flag any technical/contract edits. I'm pasting the relevant excerpt from Dana's must-haves for clarity.

> Dana's must-haves:
> - Private offers + SKU mapping to billing
> - Tenant isolation guarantees + network/egress controls

Draft responses (high-level):
1) Private offers & billing: Redwood supports private offers through marketplace private pricing integrations; we map each SKU to a marketplace listing ID and provide metering hooks (usage reports) and monthly invoice reconciliation files (CSV/JSON). Action: Kimber will send commercial-terms-summary.xlsx to Acme billing team.

2) Tenant isolation: For Dedicated and Private deployments we provide single-tenant GPU pools and VPC peering with customer-managed controls. For Hosted plans we isolate customer workloads via workload containers + strict KV-cache isolation; see attached tenant_isolation_design_diagram.png. We enforce egress rules and support customer-managed NAT/gateway for egress logging. Action: Marissa to add a short appendix on SOC2 control mappings.

3) SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II in 2027-11; full report (redacted) included in evidence bundle. For customers requiring an auditor bridge, we offer an addendum and a SOC 2 annual update commitment in our enterprise contract.

I'll assemble the commercial spreadsheet and ask Legal to pre-clear the commercial bullets for the private offer flow.

Kimberly Park
